# 1 Chronicles Chapter 28 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 384v–385r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/1CH_028_page_001.jpg, 1CH_028_page_002.jpg

---

**28:1** And-assembled [vayyaqhel] David all the-officers [sarey] of-Yisra'el — the-officers of-the-tribes, and-the-officers of-the-divisions [ha-machleqot] the-ones-serving [ha-mesharetim] the-king, and-the-commanders of-the-thousands and-the-commanders of-the-hundreds, and-the-officers of-all the-property [ha-rekhush] and-the-livestock [ha-miqneh] of-the-king and-his-sons, with the-eunuchs [ha-sarisim] and-the-mighty-men [ha-gibborim] and-every mighty-man of-valor [gibbor chayil] — to-Yerushalayim.

**28:2** And-stood David the-king upon his-feet and-said: Hear-me [shema'uni], my-brothers and-my-people! I — [it was] with my-heart [im levavi] to-build a-house-of-rest [beyt menuchah] for-the-ark of-the-covenant [aron berit] of-YHWH and-for-the-footstool [va-chadom] of-the-feet of-our-God [eloheyna], and-I-prepared [va-hakhiynotiy] to-build. **28:3** But-God [ha-elohim] said to-me: You-shall-not build a-house for-my-name [li-shmi], for a-man of-wars [ish milchamot] [are] you, and-blood [damim] you-have-shed [shafakhta].

**28:4** And-chose YHWH, God of-Yisra'el, in-me from-all the-house of-my-father to-be king over Yisra'el forever [le-olam]; for in-Yehudah he-chose [bachar] as-ruler [le-nagid], and-in-the-house of-Yehudah — the-house of-my-father, and-among-the-sons of-my-father — in-me he-was-pleased [ratsah] to-make-king [le-hamlikh] over all Yisra'el. **28:5** And-from-all my-sons — for many sons [banim rabbim] gave to-me YHWH — he-chose in-Shelomoh my-son to-sit upon the-throne of-the-kingdom [kisse malkhut] of-YHWH over Yisra'el.

**28:6** And-he-said to-me: Shelomoh your-son — he shall-build my-house and-my-courts [va-chatserotay], for I-have-chosen in-him to-me as-a-son [le-ven], and-I will-be to-him as-a-father [le-av]. **28:7** And-I-will-establish [va-hakhiynotiy] his-kingdom forever [ad le-olam], if he-is-strong [im yechezaq] to-do my-commandments [mitsvotay] and-my-judgments [u-mishpatay] as-this-day [ka-yom ha-zeh].

**28:8** And-now, before-the-eyes-of [le-eyney] all Yisra'el, the-assembly [qehal] of-YHWH, and-in-the-ears [u-ve-ozney] of-our-God — keep [shimru] and-seek [ve-dirshu] all the-commandments [mitsvot] of-YHWH your-God, so-that you-may-possess [tiyreshu] the-good land [ha-arets ha-tovah] and-leave-it-as-inheritance [ve-hinchalt'em] to-your-sons after-you forever [ad olam].

**28:9** And-you, Shelomoh my-son, know [da] the-God of-your-father and-serve-him [ve-ovdehu] with-a-whole heart [be-lev shalem] and-with-a-willing soul [u-ve-nefesh chafetsah], for all hearts [kol levavot] searches [doresh] YHWH, and-every inclination of-thoughts [yetser machashavot] he-understands [mevin]. If you-seek-him [im tidreshennu], he-will-let-himself-be-found [yimmatse] by-you; and-if you-forsake-him [im ta'azvennu], he-will-reject-you [yaznichacha] forever [la-ad].

**28:10** See [re'eh] now, for YHWH has-chosen in-you to-build a-house for-the-sanctuary [le-miqdash]; be-strong [chazaq] and-do [va-aseh].

**28:11** And-gave David to-Shelomoh his-son the-pattern [tavnit] of-the-porch [ha-ulam] and-its-houses [u-veytav], and-its-treasuries [ve-ganazzav], and-its-upper-rooms [va-aliyyotav], and-its-inner-rooms [va-chadarav ha-penimim], and-the-house of-the-mercy-seat [beyt ha-kapporet]; **28:12** and-the-pattern [tavnit] of-all that was with-him by-the-spirit [ba-ruach] — of-the-courts [chatserot] of-the-house of-YHWH, and-of-all the-chambers [ha-leshakhot] all-around, of-the-treasuries [otserot] of-the-house of-God [ha-elohim] and-of-the-treasuries of-the-holy-things [ha-qodashim];

**28:13** and-for-the-divisions [machleqot] of-the-priests and-the-Levi'im, and-for-all the-work of-the-service [melekhet avodat] of-the-house of-YHWH, and-for-all the-vessels [kelim] of-the-service of-the-house of-YHWH;

**28:14** the-gold by-weight [ba-mishqal] — the-gold for-all the-vessels of-service and-service [avodah va-avodah]; for-all the-vessels of-silver, by-weight, for-all the-vessels of-service and-service; **28:15** and-the-weight for-the-lampstands [menorot] of-gold and-their-lamps [neroteyhem] of-gold — by-the-weight of-lampstand and-lampstand and-its-lamps; and-for-the-lampstands of-silver — by-weight for-a-lampstand and-its-lamps, according-to-the-service of-lampstand and-lampstand;

**28:16** and-the-gold by-weight for-the-tables of-the-arrangement [shulchanot ha-ma'arekhet], for-table and-table; and-silver for-the-tables of-silver; **28:17** and-the-forks [ha-mizlagot] and-the-bowls [ha-mizraqot] and-the-pitchers [ha-qesvot] — pure gold [zahav tahor]; and-for-the-basins [keforey] of-gold — by-weight for-basin and-basin; and-for-the-basins of-silver — by-weight for-basin and-basin;

**28:18** and-for-the-altar of-incense [mizbach ha-qetoret], refined gold [zahav mezuqqaq] by-weight; and-for-the-pattern [tavnit] of-the-chariot [ha-merkavah] — the-cherubim [ha-keruvim] of-gold, the-ones-spreading [porshim] and-covering [ve-sokhekhim] over the-ark of-the-covenant [aron berit] of-YHWH.

**28:19** All [this] in-writing [bi-khtav] from-the-hand of-YHWH upon me — he-gave-understanding [hiskil] — all the-works [ma'asey] of-the-pattern [ha-tavnit].

**28:20** And-said David to-Shelomoh his-son: Be-strong [chazaq] and-be-courageous [ve-emats] and-do [va-aseh]; do-not fear [al tira] and-do-not be-dismayed [ve-al techat], for YHWH God [elohim] — my-God [elohay] — [is] with-you [immakh]; he-will-not release-you [lo yarpeha] and-not forsake-you [ve-lo ya'azveha] until finishing [ad likhlot] all the-work of-the-service [melekhet avodat] of-the-house of-YHWH.

**28:21** And-behold, the-divisions [machleqot] of-the-priests and-the-Levi'im for-all the-service of-the-house of-God [ha-elohim]; and-with-you in-all the-work [ba-kol melakhah] — every willing-one [kol nadiv] with-wisdom [be-chokhmah] for-every service [avodah]; and-the-officers [ha-sarim] and-all the-people — for-all your-words [divareykha].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — beyt menuchah (house-of-rest):** David describes the temple not as a house of worship but as a "house of rest" for the ark — a permanent dwelling after the ark's long journey from Sinai through the wilderness, Shiloh, Philistine captivity, and David's tent. The temple is the ark's final resting place.

**v.2 — chadom raglav (footstool of-his-feet):** The ark is described as God's footstool — implying that God's throne is in heaven and the ark is merely where his feet rest on earth. This is remarkably sophisticated theology: the temple houses not God himself but the lowest extremity of his cosmic presence.

**v.11-12 — tavnit (pattern):** The word *tavnit* is the same used for the tabernacle pattern shown to Moses on Sinai (Exod 25:9, 40). The Chronicler deliberately parallels David with Moses: both receive a divinely revealed blueprint. The phrase "by the spirit" (*ba-ruach*) in v.12 indicates this was revealed through the Holy Spirit.

**v.18 — ha-merkavah (the-chariot):** The cherubim are called "the chariot" — a stunning image. The ark with its covering cherubim is God's throne-chariot, echoing Ezekiel's chariot vision (Ezek 1, 10). This is the only place in the Hebrew Bible where the ark-and-cherubim ensemble is explicitly called a *merkavah*.

**v.19 — bi-khtav mi-yad YHWH (in-writing from-the-hand of-YHWH):** David claims the temple blueprints came from a written document from God's own hand — a remarkable parallel to the tablets of the law given to Moses. The temple plan has the same authority as Torah.

*— EMET*
